story.title: Saurav Das Barred from UK Flight, Criticizes Indian Government
story.summary: Saurav Das, a leader of the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP), was prevented from boarding a flight to the UK due to his passport being flagged by immigration authorities at Delhi airport. He received a notice from the Chennai Regional Passport Office shortly before his scheduled departure, but the government has not provided any explanation for the action taken against him.

related_stories.title: Rep. Jimmy Gomez Resigns Following Ethics Panel Findings on Misconduct
related_stories.summary: Representative Jimmy Gomez, a Democrat from California, announced his resignation effective December 1 after a House Ethics panel found evidence of sexual misconduct. This resignation follows Gomez's loss in the recent reelection bid and marks him as the second California Democrat to resign this year over similar allegations.

related_stories.title: Pope Francis' Diaries Reveal Spiritual Struggles and Encounters with the Devil
related_stories.summary: Excerpts from Pope Francis' personal diaries have been published, detailing his spiritual crisis and visions of the devil. The writings reflect his grappling with the clergy sexual abuse scandal and his experiences of mystical encounters throughout his ministry. This release marks the first publication of such personal reflections since the 1960s.

related_stories.title: China Reveals Crew for Upcoming Space Mission Including Pakistani Astronaut
related_stories.summary: China has announced the crew for its upcoming Shenzhou-24 mission, which includes Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, a Pakistani astronaut. Ali will be the first foreigner to board China's Tiangong space station. The mission is set to launch on Wednesday.

related_stories.title: Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia Amid Economic Focus
related_stories.summary: Jensen Huang has returned to his role as CEO of Nvidia, a move that President Trump claims will bolster the nation's economic growth through advancements in artificial intelligence. Trump's involvement in Huang's return highlights the administration's emphasis on AI as a key driver for economic development.
